scope: Fresh narrow soap-foam source gap only; doctor and nursery old art preserved. No runtime binding or action score.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent 2D soap-foam cutout for a preschool mermaid storybook game.
Primary request: create ONE freshly drawn, polished, compact cluster of clean soap foam and a few round soap bubbles, suitable for a washing-hands activity. A low, wide, scalloped foam cushion made from five or six overlapping rounded lobes, with three small airy bubbles rising just above it. The content silhouette is about1.7 times wider than tall and remains clear at80 pixels wide.
Style/medium: hand-painted and hand-inked TWO-DIMENSIONAL children's storybook toy-playset art. Rounded friendly forms; thin confident muted navy-purple contours; broad painted value bands; two or three quiet tones per lobe. Matte simplified paint, tiny restrained cream highlight patches, soft aqua and lavender shadows. Soft pastel cream, mint-aqua, pale blue and lavender. An illustration, with no realistic optical reflections or simulated glass.
Composition: centered complete cluster, generous transparent margin on every side, clean isolated alpha, no clipping. A flat front view, not an isometric object. True transparent background.
Constraints: only the foam/bubbles. No sink, tap, hands, character, room, floor, label, letters, border, diagram rings, star sparkles or drop shadow. No photorealism,3D rendering, shiny plastic, gradients that imply realistic spherical volume, glass/refraction, glitter, white fringe, watermark or logo. Keep every bubble circular and each outline clean and continuous.
